task: Simplify scripts/: stock hooks, merged mutation gate, Python integration lifecycle
rules: pyproject.toml import-linter contracts and tests/test_architecture.py own the runtime package layers (public facades -> interfaces -> composition -> adapters -> application -> domain) and inner effect ownership. tests/test_integration_tool_boundaries.py keeps test and script tooling out of the runtime package and keeps stand tooling that runs before environment resolution on the standard library. Development tooling never becomes a runtime dependency.

modules.responsibility: Source-level guard that inner layers do not own external effects, complementing import-linter.
modules.interface: inspect_source(source, module) -> list of violations; check_tree(package) -> list of violations for the whole package. No CLI; tests/test_architecture.py asserts the real package is clean and that fixtures with forbidden effects fail.
modules.layer: Test tooling, outside the runtime package.
modules.effects: Reads package source files passed by the caller; no other effects.

modules.responsibility: Operator and integration-test helper that clones a CVAT project onto S3 cloud storage, preserving per-task frame order.
modules.interface: main() CLI with --source/--dest/--cloud-storage-id; clone_task_images and remap helpers used by tests/integration/test_review_remediation.py. Cloud-storage parsing now comes from cveta2.adapters.cvat.storage.parse_cloud_storage.
modules.layer: Integration test tooling, outside the runtime package.
forbidden_dependencies: being imported by any cveta2 runtime module
modules.effects: CVAT and S3 network IO owned by this standalone helper.

modules.responsibility: Run mutmut over the configured scope or profile, keep mutants/ consistent with the scope fingerprint, and turn results into a pass/fail verdict against the equivalent-mutant allowlist.
modules.interface: python scripts/mutation.py [--profile NAME] [mutmut args...]; exit 0 when every mutant is killed or allowlisted, 1 on an unknown profile, an escaped mutant, a stale allowlist entry or missing stats. Replaces mutation_test.sh, mutation_config.py and mutation_gate.py.
modules.layer: Development tooling, outside the runtime package.
forbidden_dependencies: being imported by any cveta2 runtime module
modules.effects: Owns subprocesses (uv run mutmut) and the generated mutants/ workspace.

modules.responsibility: Resolve one integration run (arming file, k8s-infra skill, run tag, Secret-derived environment) and drive up, test, stop and the pre-push gate on the shared stands.
modules.interface: python -m tests.integration.lifecycle {env,up,test,stop,gate} [--repo-root PATH]; env prints shell exports; gate accepts --keep-stack and pytest arguments. Exit codes and messages match the replaced shell scripts; tag precedence INFRA_RUN_TAG > main slot > .run-tag > mint.
modules.layer: Integration test tooling, outside the runtime package; runs before pytest and before tests.env_isolation.
allowed_dependencies: k8s-infra helper scripts, uv, curl and git as subprocesses
forbidden_dependencies: being imported by any cveta2 runtime module
modules.effects: Owns subprocesses, the tests/integration/.run-tag file, the coco8 image download and the process environment handed to children.

modules.responsibility: Translate opaque CVAT cloud-storage objects into CloudStorageInfo.
modules.interface: parse_cloud_storage(cs_raw) -> CloudStorageInfo, unchanged; only the docstring reference to the removed script changes.

contracts.rules: Exhaustive inward layers and adapter independence for the cveta2 package (import-linter).
No cveta2 runtime module imports tests or scripts; negative cases inject both imports.
tests/integration/lifecycle.py imports only the standard library; negative cases inject cveta2 and SDK imports and must fail.

checks.command: uv run lint-imports && uv run pytest -n 0 tests/test_architecture.py
checks.expectation: Layer contracts kept; check_tree on the real package returns no violations; effect fixtures still fail.
Runtime modules import no tooling; lifecycle.py imports only the standard library; injected forbidden imports are reported.
Every behaviour asserted for the shell scripts holds for the Python replacements, including tag precedence, refusals, teardown matrix, TLS reporting and profile resolution before mutation work.

checks.command: uv run python -m tests.integration.lifecycle up && uv run python -m tests.integration.lifecycle test tests/integration/test_upload.py && uv run python -m tests.integration.lifecycle stop
checks.expectation: A minted tag is seeded, tested and fully removed; exact-tag listings are empty afterwards.
Documented commands, paths and links resolve after the removals.

documentation: scripts/README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, .specify/memory/engineering.md, .specify/memory/architecture.md, .claude/skills/{commit,mutation-testing,running-integration-tests}, tests/integration/.env.example and integration docstrings; historical specs and plans are not rewritten.
